# Contributing

Read README, limitations and existing tests before proposing changes. Discuss protocol, API or compatibility changes in an issue first. Keep patches focused; separate refactoring from behavior changes. Use Conventional Commits and preserve backward compatibility unless a documented migration is agreed.

Run the checks documented in README and `.github/workflows` for the affected component. Include tests for meaningful behavior changes, failure cases and security boundaries. Never include credentials, private datasets or customer data; confirm permission before contributing data or models.

Preserve original copyright and license notices. Your contribution must be compatible with the license of the files you modify; third-party files retain their own licenses. Add attribution for reused code. Do not relicense upstream code or sign a CLA on anyone else's behalf.

Maintainer: Ivan Zorin (localzet), creator@localzet.com. Source: https://github.com/localzet/secure-channel. See `.github/AUTHORS.md` and `.github/SECURITY.md`.
